title: May 10, 2022 Austin City Council Discussion
transcript:
THE AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL WILL MEET ON 
TUESDAY, MAY 10, 2022, AT 10:00 AM, AT GEORGIAN 
ACRES NEIGHBORHOOD PARK, 500 E POWELL LN, 
AUSTIN, TX 78753 
 
 
 
Press Conference 
 
10:00 AM 
Attend a press conference to discuss the 2021 economic impact of the Austin City Limits 
(ACL) Festival on the City of Austin. 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken. 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.
